description: Insert content before or after a specific line in a note. Find the target line by text search or line number. More efficient than replacing the entire note content. Requires 'write' scope.

id.description: The UUID of the note to patch.

insert_after.description: Content to insert after the matched line. Mutually exclusive with insert_before.

insert_before.description: Content to insert before the matched line. Mutually exclusive with insert_after.

line_number.description: Explicit line number (1-indexed, relative to note body after frontmatter). Alternative to search.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the search pattern to target (1-indexed). Default: 1.

search.description: Text to search for to find the target line. Use find_in_note first to verify.

name: patch_note
